closed_reasons: All value-moving endpoints require a contract-issued position SFT (farm/wrapped/LK/redeem token) or whitelisted/owner caller; none moves third-party value for an outsider
legacy farms: exitFarm bound to farm-token holders; migration endpoints callable only by old-farm SC (which no longer exposes migrate)
simple-lock legacy: unlockTokens only for contract-issued LK SFTs; upgrade is protocol-owner path
delegation: unStake/unBond/claimRewards are per-caller; dust cleanup and claimUnusedFunds are only_owner
price discovery: redeem bricked by missing lockTokens at configured legacy simple-lock (revert proven on-chain); only owner can repoint
WEGLD swap: no ESDT withdrawal endpoint exists

poc.note: Read-only measurement phase; no fork PoC run (no E-U path to prove). Undisclosed-E-U residual would require a fork exploit of deployed legacy WASM, which no runtime evidence suggests.

key_facts: 75 addresses measured with exhaustive nonce-paged token/NFT reads for the fund-holding targets (raw/full_balances.json, raw/candidate_balances.json); 49 deployments source-verified, 520 deployed-source files extracted
E-U = $0 across all audited targets; H-O = $6,782,224.00 dominated by the legacy delegation contract (1,584,732.64 EGLD user-owed, 35,601 users)
Price-discovery brick proof: tx 62f1ce1040951db5beea265e6cb20e09ed33a00d289035ffb0b87b262a7e7bd4 -> returnMessage 'invalid function (not found)' (lockTokens missing on simple_lock_legacy_0)
proxy v1 + metabonding LKMEX totals required nonce-paged reads: 28.72B and 31.91B respectively
LKMEX->MEX unlock is live and matured (factory unlockAssets permissionless; successful txs daily), so LKMEX valued at MEX parity
Unclaimed SC developer rewards across candidates: 56.294 EGLD = $227.05 (deployer-only, P)
caveats: LKMEX valued at MEX parity ($6.087e-7); LKMEX market is illiquid if force-sold (outstanding 434.7B ~= $264.6k)
Some SFT positions (MEXFARML, LKLP, locked-farm, LK SFTs) unpriced -> H-O is conservative
v1.3-unlocked/custom farms, simple-lock 0/1 and delegation v0.5.8 binary were screened (WASM exports + live activity) rather than line-by-line source verified
Delegation unbonding is subject to network unbond period (1,440,000 blocks); claims/unstakes proven live
No fork-PoC was run; source+on-chain gate analysis only
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from MultiversX legacy remnants: all $6.78M (H-O) sits behind contract-issued position SFTs or owner keys; the only bricked value is $1.18k in three Maiar price-discovery contracts (redeem forwards to a legacy simple-lock missing lockTokens) plus $0.70 stray tokens at the WEGLD swap.
